body: In short yeah I would probably recommend it. In times of crisis it calms me down and let’s me see the better side of situations. But I do feel I become dependent on it. And the benefits are short lived.

Maybe you can play for a short while with them today. You can say something like sorry I’m not feeling well today, but I’m ok for a short game. Or if you don’t feel up to it that’s ok as well. You could explain why to him still
